text:
Type: low two-door storage cabinet
Use: storing media, games, dishes and books behind doors; living room, dining room, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: high-gloss lacquered door fronts, white laminated board body, small plastic feet
Colors: glossy off-white, warm white
Shape: long low rectangular box with two flush handleless doors, crisp square edges, tiny feet, clean unbroken front, sleek and compact, medium visual weight
Feel: sleek, bright, clean, calm
Goes with: light or dark wood, grey sofas, black or chrome accents; modern, minimalist or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: BEST
product.description: May be completed with knobs or handles. Sold separately. Drill template for marking of hole positions for handles or knobs is sold separately. View more product information A simple unit can be enough storage for a limited space or the foundation for a larger storage solution if your needs change.
